subject: Password reset link expired

body: I cancelled yesterday but the account still says the subscription will renew.

body: My team invitation has expired. How can the administrator send a new one?

body: I was charged after the trial and want a refund. I may contact a regulator.

body: The dashboard takes more than a minute to load but eventually opens.

subject: Move subscription to new card
body: I need future subscription payments to use our new corporate card.

body: The account recovery page rejects my identity verification documents.

body: How can I download a copy of my purchase and invoice history?

body: There are three transactions I did not authorize and I need the account secured now.

body: I replaced my laptop and need to reconnect it to the existing workspace.

body: Something is wrong with the platform but I cannot explain what changed or provide an error message.
